pages.title: Anvil Work Copper
pages.text: Input: Annealed Copper Billet. Work: 8. Output: 1 Copper Ingot. Forge order: flatten > draw > bend > flatten.

pages.title: Bread From Campfire Dough
pages.text: Input: Doughs/Wheat. Cooking time (ticks): 600. Output: 1 Bread.

pages.title: Bread From Smoking Dough
pages.text: Input: Doughs/Wheat. Cooking time (ticks): 100. Output: 1 Bread.

pages.title: Brew Tannin Solution
pages.text: Input: Tree Bark. Input count: 4. Fluid: Water. Fluid (mB): 1000. Produced fluid: Tannin Solution. Produced fluid (mB): 1000. Duration (ticks): 6000. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.title: Fire Clay Brick
pages.text: Input: Unfired Clay Brick. Cooking time (ticks): 400. Output: 1 Brick.

pages.title: Fire Clay Bucket
pages.text: Input: Unfired Clay Bucket. Cooking time (ticks): 600. Output: 1 Clay Bucket.

pages.title: Fleece Dyeing
pages.text: This special crafting recipe preserves item colour or tool state. See the fleece, bedding, or tanning entry for its exact layout and requirements.

pages.title: Furnace Cast Copper
pages.text: Crucible Furnace. Input: 3 Raw Copper and reusable Casting Mold. Requires 1085°C for 240 processing ticks. Base ceiling: 800°C; use Bellows for a temporary 1150°C ceiling. Fuel uses native furnace burn times across recipes.

pages.title: Grind Bone
pages.text: Input: Bone. Duration (ticks): 32. Output: 3 Bone Meal. Stages: crush 2 strikes, grind 32 ticks.

pages.title: Grind Charcoal
pages.text: Input: Charcoal. Duration (ticks): 40. Output: 2 Charcoal Powder. Stages: crush 1 strikes, grind 40 ticks.

pages.title: Grind Grog
pages.text: Input: Brick. Input count: 1. Duration (ticks): 40. Output: 1 Grog. Stages: crush 3 strikes, grind 40 ticks.

pages.title: Grind Ochre
pages.text: Input: Raw Ochre. Duration (ticks): 48. Output: 2 Ground Ochre. Stages: crush 2 strikes, grind 48 ticks.

pages.title: Heavy Leather
pages.text: Input: Leather. Input count: 2. Fluid: Tannin Solution. Fluid (mB): 500. Duration (ticks): 12000. Output: 1 Heavy Leather. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.title: Mix Mortar
pages.text: Input: Sand. Input count: 2. Fluid: Water. Fluid (mB): 250. Duration (ticks): 1200. Output: 4 Wet Mortar. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.title: Mold Unfired Clay Brick
pages.text: Input: Clay Ball. Input count: 1. Presses: 2. Output: 1 Unfired Clay Brick.

pages.title: Mold Unfired Refractory Brick
pages.text: Input: Refractory Clay. Input count: 1. Presses: 2. Output: 1 Unfired Refractory Brick.

pages.title: Quern Grog
pages.text: Input: Brick. Input count: 1. Work: 40. Output: 2 Grog.

pages.title: Quern Ochre
pages.text: Input: Raw Ochre. Input count: 4. Work: 60. Output: 8 Ground Ochre.

pages.title: Quern Wheat Flour
pages.text: Input: Wheat. Input count: 4. Work: 60. Output: 4 Flour.

pages.title: Ret Plant Fibre
pages.text: Input: Plant Fibre. Input count: 4. Fluid: Water. Fluid (mB): 250. Duration (ticks): 1200. Output: 4 Retted Fibre. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.title: Soak Raw Hide
pages.text: Input: Raw Hides. Fluid: Water. Fluid (mB): 250. Duration (ticks): 2400. Output: 1 Soaked Hide. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.title: Spin Twine
pages.text: Input: Retted Fibre. Input count: 2. Duration (ticks): 32. Output: 2 Twine.

pages.title: Tan Scraped Hide
pages.text: Input: Scraped Hide. Fluid: Tannin Solution. Fluid (mB): 250. Duration (ticks): 12000. Output: 1 Tannin-Soaked Hide. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.text: Input: Raw Fleece. Fluid: Water. Fluid (mB): 250. Duration (ticks): 600. Output: 1 Clean Wool. Keep barrel sealed.

pages.title: Weave Cloth From String
pages.text: Input: Strings. Input count: 4. Passes: 4. Output: 1 Cloth.

pages.title: Wheel Casting Mold
pages.text: Input: Refractory Clay. Input count: 2. Work: 8. Output: 1 Unfired Casting Mold.

pages.title: Wheel Crucible
pages.text: Input: Refractory Clay. Input count: 3. Work: 8. Output: 1 Unfired Crucible.

pages.title: Copper Fasteners
pages.text: Stone Anvil. Input: 1 Copper Ingot. Heat to at least 500°C, then Flatten > Draw > Bend with a Stone Hammer. Output: 8 Copper Fasteners. Cooling duration: 1200 ticks from maximum temperature to ambient.
